summary.lv: Ubiquiti Latvia meklē Front-End Developer ar 3+ gadu pieredzi JavaScript, TypeScript un React, kurš izstrādās un uzturēs augstas pieejamības web pakalpojumus un UI komponentes starptautiskā Agile komandā.
summary.en: Ubiquiti Latvia seeks a Front-End Developer with 3+ years experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, and React to develop and maintain highly reliable web services and UI components in an international Agile team.
